dedupe_keys.name: inventaire des centrales hydroelectriques existantes en wallonie be

description: Inventaire des centrales hydroélectriques existantes en Wallonie (BE) is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SPW-SG Secrétariat général. The data layer of hydropower plants corresponds to a survey of existing hydropower plants in Wallonia. The data is presented here in its INSPIRE compliant version. Coverage: SPW-SG Secrétariat général. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE - Inventory of existing hydropower plants in Wallonia (BE)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SPW-SG Secrétariat général. Its keywords include directive relative à la qualité de l'eau, Régional, énergie hydroélectrique, compagnie d'électricité, CWAPE, bâtiment. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GEOJSON, GMZ, WMS. The listing shows 2022-11-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
